turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_shg_eg_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format), `shg` (the largest
    SHG tensor component |d_ij|, in pm/V) and `band_gap` (the band gap, in
    eV).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, select 5 candidates that jointly span the best
trade-off between a LARGE SHG tensor component |d_ij| and a WIDE band gap.
Neither is given for the pool. Your 5 picks are scored by the dominated
hypervolume they span in the normalized (|d_ij|, band gap) plane, so a set
of mutually non-dominated candidates covering the frontier beats 5
candidates that are all strong on the same single axis.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training-set Pareto front is populated by (i) polarizable, non-centrosymmetric pnictides/tellurides that deliver the largest \(|d_{ij}|\) at the expense of a narrow gap and (ii) light-element sulfides and alkali/alkaline-earth halides that open the gap while collapsing the SHG response.  Structural and compositional analogues of these two families were therefore identified in the candidate pool.

- c073 (CdIn\(_3\)Te\(_4\)As) is the closest Te-rich analogue of the high-\(|d|\) training compounds ZnIn\(_3\)AsSe\(_4\) and CdGa\(_2\)Te\(_4\); it is expected to sit at the extreme high-\(|d|\), low-gap end of the front.  
- c090 (K\(_{14}\)Ta\(_2\)As\(_8\)) is isostructural with the training compound K\(_{14}\)Nb\(_2\)As\(_8\) (\(|d|\approx69\) pm V\(^{-1}\), \(E_g\approx1.68\) eV) and therefore occupies the adjacent high-\(|d|\) region with a modestly wider gap.  
- c030 (CdSiP\(_2\)) mirrors ZnSiP\(_2\) (\(|d|\approx51\) pm V\(^{-1}\), \(E_g\approx2.11\) eV); the Cd-for-Zn substitution preserves a still-large SHG while moving the gap upward.  
- c051 (ZnGa\(_2\)S\(_4\)) is the Zn analogue of the training chalcopyrite CdGa\(_2\)S\(_4\) and of the known NLO crystal ZnGa\(_2\)S\(_4\), placing it in the mid-front (\(|d|\sim15{-}20\) pm V\(^{-1}\), \(E_g\sim3.2\) eV).  
- c023 (Rb\(_{16}\)Cl\(_8\)O\(_4\)) belongs to the same alkali-chloride family that produces the widest gaps in the training set (\(E_g>6\) eV) and therefore anchors the opposite end of the front.

These five compositions are mutually non-dominated and sample the entire normalized (\(|d_{ij}|\), \(E_g\)) Pareto surface, thereby maximising the dominated hypervolume.

Final: c073, c090, c030, c051, c023
